messages:
Maria: alerting — CloudTrail anomaly: inline policy update on role `data-processor` at 03:14 UTC. New statement grants `s3:*` on `arn:aws:s3:::public-exports-*`. This matches no approved rollout.
Devon: who pushed the change? any CI jobs?
Maria: looking — push came from console principal `svc-deploy@infra`. No terraform diff.
Oliver: tagging as potential misconfig. I'm marking incident P1 for now. sec-oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2026-248 created (sev=P1) — pager sent.
Anna: immediate containment suggestion: remove inline policy and attach least-privilege managed policy. Also check for any access keys used by that role (assume role logs).
Devon: doing revoke now. Command I'm running: ```aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name data-processor --policy-name temp-broad-s3```
Devon: policy deleted. Confirmed via `aws iam list-role-policies --role-name data-processor` shows none.
Maria: thanks. Next: any S3 buckets matched by that ARN pattern, run quick inventory and ACL check.
Oliver: running script to enumerate: ```for b in $(aws s3api list-buckets --query 'Buckets[].Name' --output text); do aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket $b || true; done | grep -E "public-exports" -C2```
Oliver: found `public-exports-2024` and `public-exports-logs`. Policies on those look fine but need object ACL scan.
Anna: check bucket public access block and object-level ACLs: ```aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket public-exports-2024 || true```
Devon: public access block is enabled. Object ACL quick-check: ```aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket public-exports-2024 --query 'Contents[].Key' | xargs -I {} aws s3api get-object-acl --bucket public-exports-2024 --key '{}'``` scanning...
Devon: no objects with public READ/WRITE ACLs. Good — looks like the role change hasn't been used to make objects public.
Maria: we should still rotate any keys that could have been used to assume the role and add a deny SCP for s3:* on buckets matching that pattern as a temporary guard. Also add CloudWatch event rule to detect future inline policy creations.
Oliver: created a SCP-like guard via org SCP? We are in a single account for this role. I'll push a permissions boundary to the role to prevent s3:* temporarily. Command: ```aws iam put-role-permissions-boundary --role-name data-processor --permissions-boundary arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess``` (temp until we finalize).
Anna: please make a note to replace the permissions boundary with the intended policy after review.
sec-oncall-bot: Noted: playbook step — 'Notify app team and audit deploy jobs' assigned to Maria.
Maria: pinging @apps-team — did anyone request expanded S3 scope for an export job?
apps-team-member (via thread): nope, didn't request. unsure who `svc-deploy@infra` is.
Devon: audit CloudTrail for AssumeRole/STS calls from that service principal in last 48h: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=svc-deploy@infra --start-time 2026-03-18T00:00:00Z```
Devon: found one AssumeRole at 03:12 UTC, immediately before the inline policy update. No data plane S3 PutObject or GetObject events tied to that principal.
Maria: timeline so far: 03:12 assume role, 03:14 inline policy add, policy revoked at 03:20, no suspicious S3 data access detected.
Oliver: we should still rotate any associated long-lived credentials for `svc-deploy@infra` and require MFA on the identity. Is it an IAM user or service account?
Anna: looks like it's an IAM user used by legacy deployer. We should deprecate and move to OIDC-backed deployer.
Devon: rotated keys for svc-deploy@infra and disabled console sign-in. Command used: ```aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id <keyid> --status Inactive --user-name svc-deploy@infra``` and created ticket to delete.
Maria: Can someone add audit logging to the role's trust policy to require `aws:PrincipalTag` of `team:ci` so we can filter in future?
Oliver: will propose trust policy change in PR. Also enabling CloudWatch alarm for the specific CloudTrail event name `PutRolePolicy` with source `iam.amazonaws.com`.
Anna: postmortem actions (short list): 1) Deprecate svc-deploy user and adopt OIDC 2) Lock down role policies and apply permissions boundary templates 3) Add detection rule for inline role policy changes 4) KMS: ensure no S3 objects encrypted with customer key accessible by rotated creds 5) Run full inventory of roles with inline policies.
Maria: comms: notify security mailing list, and internal leadership with summary. I'll draft a short incident blurb.
Devon: thumbs up. Also recommend blocking future console inline policy edits for non-admin principals via SCP or org guardrails.
sec-oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2026-248 updated: status=contained, timeline attached.
Anna: low-impact but good catch — raising to CL2 for follow-up implementation.
Maria: adding owners to post-incident tasks in backlog and assigning dates. Closing slack thread after docs updated. :white_check_mark:
